about: The one source of the native look's tokens (#273, #275): metrics.ts and controlsCopy.ts read it for the plugins, android-tokens.cjs writes it as Java for the Android apps. Each value says where it comes from; a [DEFAULT, measure in #272] is replaced by the catalog's measured value here alone.

pxPerMm.source: physical pixels per millimetre on the 299 ppi Manta screen

touchTarget.source: the smallest touch target (Ink2Pic brief section 8.4)

controlHeight.source: a button and the text field: one height, so a field and its button line up

rowButtonWidth.source: a button in a list row: one width, so the buttons of every row share a column (#68)

space.source: the one spacing step every spacing role starts from [DEFAULT, calibrate on device]

border.source: the thick ink border of a button, a tile and the field (brief section 8.4)

bodyFont.source: the body font size, near 40 px: about 2.4 mm cap height with Roboto's 0.71 cap height

minFont.source: the Supernote's own system text, the note title in the bottom bar, about 2.2 mm cap height in a device screenshot (brief section 8.4, #85); text a person must read is never smaller, and `npm run renders` fails a screen that is

titleBarHeight.source: the black band of the title bar [DEFAULT, measure in #272]

navMarkWidth.source: the bar that marks the open item of the navigation list, at its trailing edge [DEFAULT, measure in #272]

switchWidth.source: the switch's box, wide enough for «OFF» [DEFAULT, measure in #272]

radioSize.source: the radio button's ring [DEFAULT, measure in #272]

radioDot.source: the radio button's filled dot [DEFAULT, measure in #272]

iconSize.source: the drawn icons of the icon buttons: the remove ring, the trash and the download arrow [DEFAULT, measure in #272]

largeFont.source: the type ramp: the title as a multiple of the body font size

lineHeight.source: the line height of the status line, as a multiple of its font size

selectedBarBorders.source: a selected toggle's bar is this many borders thick

pageMarkBorders.source: the underline of the pager's current page, in borders [DEFAULT, measure in #272]

ink.source: text, borders, the primary button's fill

context.source: section headings, hints and values: 9.7:1 on paper (README › Grey as colour, #50)

placeholder.source: the field's placeholder: a grey that keeps 7:1 contrast on paper (interface rule 3)

selection.source: selected text in the field: a light grey, so the ink text stays readable over it

on.source: the switch when on, as the native Settings write it

off.source: the switch when off, as the native Settings write it

back.source: the spoken name of the title bar's ‹
